description:
Compute the monthly payment, total interest, and (optionally) the full schedule.

annual_rate is a nominal APR compounded monthly (periodic rate = annual_rate/12),
with monthly payments. With an extra_payment, interest_saved and payments_saved
compare against the same loan without it. By default returns just the summary; set
include_schedule=True for every row.

annual_rate.description: Annual interest rate (nominal APR, compounded monthly) as a decimal, e.g. 0.06 for 6%.

extra_payment.description: Extra principal paid each month; shortens the term.

include_schedule.description: Return the full per-period amortization rows (can be large).

term_months.description: Loan term in months, e.g. 360 for 30 years.

name: loan_schedule

outputSchema.description: Amortization summary and full schedule for a loan or mortgage.

interest_saved.description: Interest the extra payment saves versus the same loan without it; 0 when extra_payment is 0.

payments_saved.description: Monthly payments the extra payment saves (months off the term) versus the same loan without it; 0 when extra_payment is 0.

items.description: One period of a loan amortization schedule.

total_interest.description: Total interest paid over the loan.

title: Loan Payment & Amortization Schedule
